# OverDrive's Executive Team

Leadership at OverDrive plays a crucial role in achieving the company's mission of creating [a world enlightened by reading](https://company.overdrive.com/company-profile/who-we-are/) . The executive team is dedicated to serving OverDrive’s partners, as well as investing in our communities and our people, worldwide.

Steve Potash

## Steve Potash

#### Founder & Chairman

Steve Potash is Founder & Chairman of OverDrive and served as CEO from 1986-2026.

...

[Follow Steve Potash on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/stevepotash/)

Marc DeBevoise

## Marc DeBevoise

#### Chief Executive Officer

Marc DeBevoise joined OverDrive in 2026 and is our Chief Executive Officer. He also serves as a member of the Board of Directors. As a recognized leader in digital media and streaming technology, Marc brings more than 20 years of experience building and scaling global content and technology platforms.

#### Read more

Prior to joining OverDrive, Marc served as CEO and Board Director of Brightcove and previously held senior leadership roles at Paramount and it's predicessors, including Chief Digital Officer of Paramount Global and CEO & President of CBS Interactive, where he helped lead the company's direct-to-consumer streaming strategy and the launches of Paramount+, CBSN, and CBS Sports HQ.

# OverDrive CEO Steve Potash Transitions to New Role

by [Hallie Rich](https://www.libraryjournal.com/author?query=Hallie%20Rich)  
Jun 23, 2026
| Filed in News

* [](https://www.facebook.com/sharer.php?u=https://www.libraryjournal.com/story/overdrive-ceo-transitions-to-new-role) [](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Article:%20https://www.libraryjournal.com/story/overdrive-ceo-transitions-to-new-role%20-%20OverDrive%20CEO%20Steve%20Potash%20Transitions%20to%20New%20Role%20%23%20Library%20Journal&source=clicktotweet&related=clicktotweet) [](mailto:?Subject=OverDrive CEO Steve Potash Transitions to New Role&Body=.. Read more in https://www.libraryjournal.com/story/overdrive-ceo-transitions-to-new-role ) 

OverDrive announced leadership transition with founder and CEO Steve Potash named Chairman of the Board. Marc DeBevoise will become next OverDrive CEO.
As OverDrive marks its 40th year in business, founder Steve Potash is embarking on a significant leadership transition, moving from his long-held role as CEO to become the Chairman of the Board. Marc DeBevoise, a veteran media and technology executive who was named President of OverDrive in March, will be his successor. This shift, announced on June 23, signals a new chapter for the company and a personal evolution for Potash, as he moves away from day-to-day operations to focus on global advocacy for literacy, support for public learning institutions, and promoting universal access to knowledge.

Potash's transition comes at a time when OverDrive has grown from a startup into a global powerhouse, serving more than 80,000 libraries and schools in 115 countries.
While he remains actively engaged in the company's long-term strategy and global growth, his primary energy will now be directed toward mission-driven leadership that reflects the company's founding vision: "a world enlightened by reading."

## A Dedicated Focus on Advocacy

One of the key pillars of Potash's new role is a deep commitment to advocating for the professionals who sustain the world's educational ecosystems. In a recent interview with _LJ_ , Potash described libraries and schools as the "connective tissue between information and opportunity." He shared that he wants "to focus my attention on the educators and library professionals who dedicate their lives to improving communities through literacy and lifelong learning."

This advocacy also extends into the realm of public policy—an area where Potash has supported right to read legislation, campaigned against book bans, and sought to create a legislative environment that's favorable to library interests.

...

" He describes the Foundation's future focus spanning multiple literacies—from early learning to digital literacy to civic literacy, as well as health literacy, a topic that's a particular passion for Potash, whose longstanding civic engagement has included a nearly decade-long stint on the University Hospitals Board of Directors in Cleveland.

## Ensuring a Strong Legacy and Future

In preparing for his transition, Potash emphasized the need for company leadership to truly understand the transformative power of libraries. "OverDrive is never the star—the hero is the librarian," says Potash. "Every major milestone or advance in our service has been because of a brilliant librarian who challenged us to either solve a pain point or to experiment."

Potash's new role will allow him to leverage more than 40 years of experience as an entrepreneur to champion the essential role of libraries in workforce development and informed communities.

**CLEVELAND — June 23, 2026 —** OverDrive announced today that veteran media and technology executive Marc DeBevoise has been appointed Chief Executive Officer. Founder Steve Potash has assumed the role of Chairman of the Board, ensuring a smooth transition and continuing to advance the company’s mission to expand access to reading and learning for institutions worldwide.

The leadership transition reflects a planned succession designed to support OverDrive’s continued growth and global expansion. Potash founded OverDrive 40 years ago and has guided the company from an early digital content venture into a global, purpose-built platform serving libraries and schools in more than 115 countries.
DeBevoise, having previously served as CEO of Brightcove, Chief Digital Officer of Paramount, and CEO of CBS Interactive, joined OverDrive as President and has worked alongside founder Steve Potash to position the company for its next phase of growth.

OverDrive CEO Marc DeBevoise stands in front of OverDrive's Blue Sky Campus, headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio. Marc DeBevoise, Chief Executive Officer of OverDrive

“Steve built an extraordinary organization — a mission-driven company with true global impact — and Marc is the ideal leader to write its next chapter,” said Richard Sarnoff, Chairman of Media, KKR Americas Private Equity. “Marc’s vision, energy, and operational depth give us every confidence that his leadership will not only augment its success as a business but also heighten its outstanding record of service to libraries and their patrons, to schools and their students, and to publishers and content owners.”
“Founding and building OverDrive has been the most rewarding journey of my career,” said Steve Potash. “With Marc leading as CEO, the company is exceptionally well positioned to grow and evolve. As Chairman, I look forward to supporting Marc and our team while continuing to champion the libraries, schools, and institutions at the heart of our mission.”

DeBevoise brings deep expertise across strategy, operations, and technology, with a clear focus on accelerating OverDrive’s momentum at home and abroad — growing the platform, expanding access to content, and building the audience of readers, learners, and viewers the company is uniquely positioned to serve.

“OverDrive has extraordinary reach, incredible momentum, and an enduring mission — and I’m thrilled to lead this company forward,” said Marc DeBevoise.
